 Bilsapur Chhattisgarh

Re
For
Applicant : Mr. Dheerendra Pandey, Advocate For Respondent-
: Mr. Dilman Rati Minj, Panel
Lawyer State Hon'ble Shri Parth Prateem Sahu, Judge Order On Board 14/08/2024
1.  This is repeated bail application.
The first application filed by the applicant was dismissed on merit vide order dated 20.05.2024 in MCRC No. 3606/2024.

Applicant has filed this third bail application under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of regular bail as he has been arrested in connection with Crime No. 988/2023 registered at Police Station - Sarkanda, District Bilaspur (C.G.) for offence punishable under Sections 420, 120(B), 34 of IPC.

2. Learned counsel for applicant submits that applicant was arrested on 25.07.2023, till April 2024 only one witness is examined and the case status obtained online would show that as on 15.07.2024 copy of evidence of witness PW-1 is only uploaded and not of others which shows that till 15.07.2024 only one witness is examined.
There are 20 enlisted witnesses.
Offence is triable by Judicial Magistrate First Class, trial may take some time, hence, applicant may be enlarged on bail.

3. Learned State counsel opposes the submission of learned counsel for applicant and would further submit that at the time of rejection of second bail application this court has considered the case on merits.
4. I have heard learned counsel for the parties.

sentences.text: Taking into consideration, facts and circumstances of the case, nature of allegation, period of pre-trial detention since last more than one year, offence is triable by Judicial Magistrate First Class and also that there are 20 enlisted witnesses out of which only one witness is examined till 15.07.2024 as stated by the counsel for applicant, without commenting anything on merits of the case, I am inclined to allow this bail application.
6. Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant shall be released on regular bail, upon furnishing a bail bond in the sum of   25,000/- with one surety in the like sum to the satisfaction of the Court on the conditions that- a) Applicant shall appear before the Trial Court regularly on each and every date,
unless exempted from appearance.
b) The applicant shall not, in any manner, tamper with the prosecution witnesses.
c) If the applicant is found involved in similar offence in future, it will be open for the State to apply for cancellation of Bail.
Certified copy as per rules.

Sd/-
 (Parth Prateem Sahu)
